email.subject: Peak Pros Fitness: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I checked out the Peak Pros Fitness site. Two things are likely costing you members:

Your footer still shows outdated info (old hours/contact), which makes new visitors double-check elsewhere or just call to confirm - friction that loses bookings. And there are no reviews showing on the site, so people comparing gyms in Harbor Falls have nothing to judge trust by before picking a competitor instead.

Both are fixable in an afternoon. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change and why?

Alex
Northlight Web
